prompt:
Use case: productivity-visual.
Create ONE finished Korean academic presentation slide, a single 16:9 landscape image at 2048x1152 if available. NOT a six-panel sheet, NOT a mockup on a desk, no external border.
Image 1 is ONLY the chosen Steel / Sky visual style reference: its six tiles demonstrate a style, not your output layout. Rebuild just the requested individual slide at full size.
STYLE LOCK: #355872 dark steel for text/lines; #7AAACE secondary blue; #9CD5FF sky accents; #F7F8F0 ivory background. Flat clean colors, no extra accent colors. Actual inserted photographs retain natural colors. Match the reference's strong oversized Korean sans-serif headings, thin open diagrams, generous negative space, restrained square corner motifs. Use one consistent Noto Sans KR-like sans family, bold headline around 58px, main text 32-38px at 2048 width, captions at least 23px. Main content left/right margins 110px, heading baseline near y180. One headline and one dominant composition. Slide number small top left. No random English decor, slogans, logos, middle-dot separators, neon, glossy cards, shadows, repetitive rounded cards or stock robot renders. Use commas or slashes.
CONTENT LOCK: render supplied Korean text accurately and keep all numbers/units. Do not add empirical facts, percentages, rankings or unprovided claims. A concept drawing must be labeled 개념도. Do not conflate implemented features with validated mission success. Real image inputs are supporting inserts: preserve their robot pose, actual blocks, colors and boundaries, do not reimagine or synthesize their content. Crop only for readability, retaining the evidence context. No fabricated experimental scenes.
Only the explicitly listed on-screen text should appear. Presenter notes are not to be printed. Use readable large labels, not dense report paragraphs. Produce a clean full-bleed slide.

SLIDE SPECIFICATION:
Ivory background. Title "파지가 확인된 경우에만 운반". Left 55% dominant clean flow diagram: "중심 후보 검사" then decision "실행 가능?"; yes to "접근 / 닫기", no to "대체 후보 검사" which can lead to same approach only when feasible. Then "위치 / 부하 확인" branches success "확인" to "운반" and failure "미확인" to "다음 후보 / 재선택" returning to candidate checking. Make success/failure arrows unmistakable. Right 34% stack two actual supplied photos: Image 2 held with caption "파지 관측 사례" and "위치 20.99 / 절대 부하 500"; Image 3 empty with caption "빈손 관측 사례" and "위치 2.49 / 절대 부하 44". Preserve real robot/block scenes. Bottom "위치는 서보 정규화값 / 서로 다른 위치와 방향의 관측 사례". Number "09". These are examples, never show sensor accuracy or same-condition before/after comparison.
revision_prompt:
Edit ONLY the left flowchart of Image 1. Preserve the exact entire slide title, both right-side authentic photographs and their captions, all numerical values 20.99 / 500 / 2.49 / 44, footer, palette, node positions, and existing success/failure flow after sensor verification. No changes to photographs whatsoever.
Targeted flow correction:
1. Keep "중심 후보 검사" -> decision "실행 가능?" and its "예" arrow to "접근 / 닫기" and "아니오" arrow to "대체 후보 검사".
2. Add a clear directed right-then-up arrow FROM the RIGHT EDGE of lower-left "대체 후보 검사" box TO the BOTTOM EDGE of "접근 / 닫기". The route can go right from alternative box center, then upward into approach box. Label this added arrow exactly "실행 가능 시". This is the only new wording.
3. Correct the lower return path: "다음 후보 / 재선택" returns via bottom and far-left edge ONLY to "중심 후보 검사". Remove the upward little spur arrow currently entering the BOTTOM of "대체 후보 검사". There must be no bottom arrow from that return path into the alternative candidate box.
4. Preserve "접근 / 닫기" -> "위치 / 부하 확인". Preserve sensor "확인" exclusively to "운반", and "미확인" exclusively to "다음 후보 / 재선택".
5. All arrowheads must clearly indicate direction. The alternative candidate box MUST have the new outgoing conditional route into approach; do not leave it as a dead end.
Keep all other slide content and layout exactly as is. One full 16:9 slide output.
review: Single ivory slide; two authentic source scenes visually retain corresponding robot poses, block arrangement and boundary.
Sensor values exactly 20.99 / 500 and 2.49 / 44; normalized position and different-position/direction observation caveat retained.
Initial generation omitted alternative-to-approach path. image_gen revision adds a conditional arrow labelled 실행 가능 시 and corrects the retry return path.
Centre feasible -> approach, centre infeasible -> alternative candidate, alternative feasible -> same approach; approach -> position/load verification.
Confirmed verification -> transport only. Unconfirmed verification -> next candidate/reselection -> candidate check, with no transport bypass.
Photographs retain source scene visually; generated insert is not pixel-identical source copying.
